name: Underground Cable Ampacity
description: Current-carrying capacity of an underground cable considering soil thermal resistivity uncertainty.

elements.name: Cable Ampacity
elements.description: Continuous current rating under actual soil conditions. Uncertain due to soil moisture and thermal resistivity variation.

uncertainty.source: IEC 60287 calculation with soil thermal resistivity range

elements.name: Peak Load Current
elements.description: Peak current from load flow study including N-1 contingency

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(I_amp) = I_amp if I_amp >= I_load, else ∅
consistency_relations.upr_description: The peak N-1 load current guards the cable ampacity uncertainty set; ampacity below 400 A causes thermal overload.
